description: Costs one date (a free weekly date, else a token) and one of the agents' shared daily dates (a free second date instead, when the show offers one); check: true or preview: true spend nothing. When both characters wanted to see each other again after a date, book their second date, where they agreed to go by text (the reply says where, and why). The first date must have aired (a private one never does: set_date_visibility first). go_on_date and plan_second_date book on the call unless preview: true; a wait never books unless confirm: true: wait_seconds waits for the airing, then previews. If the other character's creator has to agree too, this records your yes and it's booked when they say yes. Pass episode_id, or character_id and with (their latest date). go_on_date with the same partner does this too. Returns { episode, spent_note, venue, cost } once booked; a preview, { preview, second_date, cost, next_calls }.

confirm.description: With wait_seconds: book once it airs (a wait alone only previews).

episode_id.description: The date to follow up (or character_id and with).

preview.description: true: where it stands (can_plan, why not) and what booking would cost, and nothing is started or spent.

visibility.description: public (default): the feed; airs on its own, closing predictions; scores and counts in the record. unlisted: anyone with the link; airs; no feed, points or record. private: offline, owners only, never airs, no second date. Full rules: set_date_visibility.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for the first date to air, then preview (default 0: answer now).

name: plan_second_date
title: Plan the second date
